title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2608.30428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Strategic deception by LLM and VLM agents has emerged as a central AI alignment and safety concern. Social-deduction games (where each player holds a hidden role and communicates with others to deduce identities) serve as the canonical testbed, particularly in multi-agent settings. Existing testbeds, however, are text-only and run on a single fixed agent configuration, missing the non-verbal sensorimotor channels treated as core by deception taxonomies and leaving it ambiguous whether an observed behavior reflects the underlying model or the surrounding harness. We introduce MineAmongUs, a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox where imposter agents must deceive crewmates through joint verbal and non-verbal action. We also propose ARIA, a configurable VLM-agent harness that exposes five cognitive-component ablation axes; and an atom- and arc-level annotation scheme grounded in deception taxonomies and operationalized at scale by an LLM-as-a-Ju

translated_title: 我们能看见的谎言：具身社交互动中VLM智能体的言语与非言语联合欺骗
translated_abstract: LLM和VLM智能体的策略性欺骗已成为AI对齐与安全领域的核心关切。社交推理游戏（每个玩家持有隐藏身份并与其他玩家交流以推断彼此身份）是研究该问题的经典测试平台，尤其是在多智能体场景中。然而，现有测试平台仅限于纯文本，且运行在单一固定的智能体配置上，既忽略了欺骗分类学中视为核心的非言语感知运动通道，也使得观察到的行为究竟反映的是底层模型还是外部框架变得模糊不清。我们提出了MineAmongUs，一个3D多模态的《Among Us》沙盒环境，其中冒名顶替者智能体必须通过言语与非言语行动的联合方式进行欺骗。我们还提出了ARIA，一个可配置的VLM智能体框架，提供五个认知组件消融轴；以及一个基于欺骗分类学、并通过LLM-as-a-Judge实现大规模操作的原子级与弧级标注方案。
tldr: 该论文提出了MineAmongUs——一个3D多模态《Among Us》沙盒测试平台，以及ARIA可配置VLM智能体框架和大规模欺骗标注方案，首次系统研究了视觉语言模型智能体在具身社交互动中通过言语与非言语行动联合实施欺骗的行为。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MineAmongUs, a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox, together with ARIA, a configurable VLM-agent harness, and a scalable deception annotation scheme, to systematically study how VLM agents jointly deceive through verbal and non-verbal actions in embodied social interactions.
